title: How Bitdeer AI Builds More Reliable and Efficient Model APIs
summary: Discover how Bitdeer AI's Model as a Service (MaaS) simplifies access to leading open-source AI models through reliable APIs. Learn the key factors behind stable, efficient model inference and how to build and scale AI applications with confidence.
body_markdown:
Model as a Service (MaaS) is one of the services Bitdeer AI offers. It gives users access to model APIs, making it easy to get started with leading open-source AI models. This article covers the basics of model APIs and the key factors behind the stability and efficiency of Bitdeer AI's model API.


## **What Is a Model API?**


A model API packages the capabilities of a large language model behind an HTTP interface. Users or AI agents send prompts to a specified model through the interface and receive generated results. Bitdeer AI, for example, currently offers its[model API](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/services/ai-inference?ref=bitdeer.ai) at https://api-inference.bitdeer.ai/v1. Available models include[DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/model/explore/mdl-dahcq19535gc73e6tkpg?ref=bitdeer.ai) 、[GLM-5.3](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/model/explore/mdl-danujva0a5a5rh87sdlg?ref=bitdeer.ai) 、[GLM-5.3-Flash](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/model/explore/mdl-da9jcesfhomc73a6j740?ref=bitdeer.ai) 、[Qwen3.8-27B](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/model/explore/mdl-da68gt1e7ujs73f59d3g?ref=bitdeer.ai) 、[Kimi-K3](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/model/explore/mdl-d9jrs9rma0bc73epjn30?ref=bitdeer.ai) 、[DeepSeek-V4-Flash](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/model/explore/mdl-d9nlggo8416s73ais1h0?ref=bitdeer.ai) . It supports both OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible protocols, and each model page includes Python, cURL, and TypeScript examples for the respective protocol.


By supporting widely used inference API protocols such as OpenAI and Anthropic, Bitdeer AI's model API can be integrated easily into nearly any AI application that supports those protocols, including harnesses such as Hermes Agent, Pi, Claude Code, and Cursor.


Model APIs provide a simple, cost-effective way to use leading open-source models without taking on the complexity behind the interface. Users do not need to buy or maintain GPU servers, manage model weights themselves, or build a continuously available model inference service. Providers such as Bitdeer AI take on that complexity and focus on delivering a stable, efficient experience.


## **What Makes a Model API Reliable and Efficient?**


The following metrics are useful when evaluating model API reliability and efficiency.


- **Time to First Token (TTFT) -** the time from sending a request to receiving the first token. This metric applies to streaming requests and shows how long users wait before output begins.


- **Output tokens per second -** the number of tokens generated per second. It reflects the model's output throughput from the first token through completion.


- **Error rate -** the share of requests that return an error. A small number of errors can often be handled with retries, but retries increase task duration and can degrade the user experience.


## **How Bitdeer AI Delivers Reliability and Efficiency**


### **Advanced Infrastructure**


Bitdeer AI operates multiple[AI data centers](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/aidc?ref=bitdeer.ai) across the United States, Europe, and Asia. They use advanced power and liquid-cooling architectures and have 2 GW of power capacity under construction. The company is part of Bitdeer Technologies Group (NASDAQ: BTDR), one of[NVIDIA's first cloud partners in Southeast Asia](https://www.bitdeer.ai/en/about?ref=bitdeer.ai) , and is certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type I and Type II.


Ample high-end computing resources give Bitdeer AI's model APIs the capacity they need, while advanced GPU cluster infrastructure helps keep those resources running reliably over the long term.


### **Efficient Inference Engine**


An inference engine is the software that runs on GPU servers, executes the model, and produces tokens. Bitdeer AI continuously optimizes its inference engine in areas including the following:


- **Prefix caching -** In AI agent workloads, a large portion of each prompt often repeats context from earlier turns. That context does not need to be recomputed each time and can be reused. A high cache-hit rate can significantly improve TTFT. Bitdeer AI is also exploring multi-level caching to increase cache-hit rates further.


- **Speculative decoding -** Bitdeer AI applies advanced speculative decoding techniques. A lightweight draft model predicts the main model's output and, while maintaining the acceptance rate, can substantially increase output speed.


- **Kernel optimization -** Bitdeer AI explores optimization of key kernels in advanced models. Custom kernels can run specific operations more efficiently and make fuller use of the hardware.


- **Routing optimization -** Bitdeer AI optimizes request-routing strategies to account for replica state, including load and KV-cache status, so requests can be sent to the replica best positioned to complete them efficiently.


### **Comprehensive Inference Platform Capabilities**


- **Fault tolerance -** Bitdeer AI's MaaS platform runs service clusters in multiple locations and supports active-active deployment across regions, reducing request error rates.


- **Observability -** Bitdeer AI's MaaS platform provides comprehensive observability. Metrics, monitoring, alerting, tracing, and logging infrastructure give the team visibility into system health, enable timely responses to anomalies, and support precise diagnosis.


- **Rate limiting -** Rate-limiting policies based on factors such as capacity and wait time explicitly reject requests when they exceed the service's operating range, preventing an overload of queued requests from bringing the service down.


## **How to Get More from a Model API**


Although model API providers do their best to keep APIs reliable and efficient, users should also consider the following when integrating them to make their own applications more resilient:


- **Set a reasonable request timeout -** base it on the actual business scenario.


- **Handle request errors correctly -** add a retry mechanism so throttling or transient errors do not cause the application to fail.


- **Set a maximum retry count and a backoff interval -** unbounded retries place unnecessary load on the service.


- **Control context length -** for example, compress the context when appropriate. This helps preserve model quality and prevents errors caused by requests exceeding the model's context window.


We also recommend using an established harness to build applications or complete tasks. Mature implementations of well-known harnesses have usually already accounted for the issues above, so users do not need to manage every detail themselves.


## **Summary**


Bitdeer AI's model APIs make large models easy to use while drawing on Bitdeer AI's strengths across infrastructure, inference engines, and inference platforms. These optimizations are designed to deliver a more reliable and efficient experience for users.
